name: lemonslice
description: Monitor existing avatar sessions and their usage
long_description: Bring an existing LemonSlice API key to read session history, status and reported usage. Saving, replacing and testing list sessions and never start a billable session. This read-only connector does not create or control avatars, generate videos, or transport WebRTC/WebSocket audio and video. Create sessions separately through your existing LemonSlice integration.

examples.title: Read session history without creating or controlling an avatar
Poll an existing session; replace SESSION_ID

messages.402: LemonSlice requires available credits or an active subscription
messages.403: LemonSlice denied access; check the key, permissions and subscription
messages.429: LemonSlice rate limit reached; try again later
messages.provider_unreachable: LemonSlice could not be reached; try again
messages.unexpected_response: Unexpected LemonSlice response; credential could not be verified

presentation.tagline: Read the history and status of existing LemonSlice sessions.
presentation.setup: Create sessions outside the gateway first, then supply a LemonSlice API key from the developers dashboard.
notices: Read-only session history and status for existing LemonSlice sessions. This connector does not create or control sessions, generate video, or support WebRTC or WebSockets. Saving, replacing and testing a key only read session history; they do not start a paid session. Sessions must already be created outside the gateway.
